Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier, compound name, and canonical SMILES for all compounds reported in document CHEMBL3639326. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id, filtering by doc_chembl_id. Join compound_structures on molregno as an INNER JOIN to ensure canonical SMILES is present. Return chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles. Sort by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
